title: land accepts worker worktrees under the main checkout's .claude/worktrees when it runs in a linked worktree
goal: bl_land.release_worker_worktree, run from a clone that is a linked worktree of another checkout, accepts a finished worker's worktree under that checkout's .claude/worktrees (so land removes and lands the workers an Agent tool made there without a git worktree move), while worker_dirs, which tidy and close read, keeps only the clone's own directory; the refusal for any other path names the directory it expects.

run: import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land;d=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp());m=d+'/main';g=lambda*a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',m,*a],check=True,capture_output=True);subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',m],check=True);g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@e','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','x');g('worktree','add','-q',d+'/linked','-b','l');w=m+'/.claude/worktrees/agent-ST-aaaaaaaa';g('worktree','add','-q',w,'-b','work/ST-aaaaaaaa');r=bl_land.release_worker_worktree(d+'/linked',pathlib.Path(w),None,branch='work/ST-aaaaaaaa');t={str(p) for p in bl_land.worker_dirs(d+'/linked')};ok=r is None and m+'/.claude/worktrees' not in t;print('land releases a main checkout worker from a linked worktree, tidy keeps its own directory:',ok,r);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
